mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Chande Momentum Oscillator zero crossing identifies a reversal in the balance of raw upward versus downward close movement; follow the new sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when CMO crosses strictly above zero; short when CMO crosses strictly below zero
mechanism.why_distinct: CMO uses unsmoothed rolling sums of all positive and negative completed close changes over 14 periods. It is not RSI Wilder smoothing, a regression endpoint, moving-average crossover, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour raw gain-loss balance zero crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.change: current completed close minus immediately prior completed close
features.gains_losses: positive change in gain bucket and absolute negative change in loss bucket
features.cmo: 100*(rolling 14 gain sum-loss sum)/(gain sum+loss sum), strict positive denominator and complete gap-free window
features.event: current completed CMO strictly crosses above zero from <=0 or below zero from >=0
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Chande Momentum Oscillator(14) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no momentum period, sum formula, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Tushar Chande canonical Momentum Oscillator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: CMO=100*(sum positive close changes-sum absolute negative close changes)/(their sum) over 14 completed changes; strict zero-line crossover
external_basis.selection_use: published unsmoothed formula, common default 14, and zero-line direction only; no incidence or outcomes
